_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Tier-2 (security-critical) file patterns. Consumed by both .github/workflows/risk-tier-check.yml (PR classification) and .github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml (4-hour prod cool-off). Each string is a JavaScript RegExp source matched against a repo-relative file path. KEEP IN SYNC with SECURITY.md's 'Files that trigger Security Impact review' list. Editing this one file updates both gates at once — do not re-inline these patterns into the workflows.
